description:
Change an open portfolio order. Use this before cancel_order.

    Attach or replace the investment case with library_item_id. That is the
    document id. search_library returns it as item_id. list_library_items
    returns it as id. Pass the id, not the title. An empty library_item_id
    removes the case. The accept card and the book show it.

    qty, price, expires_kind (day, gtc, or delete_after), expires_at,
    after_hours, and library_item_id. Send only the fields that change.
    Rules still apply. HIL on,
    or an order above Skip HIL up to, opens the accept card again. A day
    order needs an open session. A good till that lasts past the next open
    can stay open while the session is closed.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID
        order_id: The order UUID
        qty: New share count
        price: New price, or the new limit
        expires_kind: day, gtc (90 days), or delete_after
        expires_at: Required with delete_after. Naive times are New York.
        after_hours: Extended session for a stock or ETF
        library_item_id: The investment case. The document id from search_library
            (item_id) or list_library_items (id). Not the title. An empty string removes the case.

library_item_id.description: Investment case to attach or replace. Pass the document id, not the title. search_library returns it as item_id. list_library_items returns it as id. An empty string removes the case.
library_item_id.title: Library Item Id

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: edit_order
title: Edit portfolio order
